function.name: e2e_customer_segmentation
function.description: [EaaS E2E Operating Model — A1.8 Customer Segmentation] Identify which customer segments are the best candidates for EaaS — based on operational maturity, contract appetite, and outcome alignment — to focus sales effort where conversion is highest. Outputs: EaaS customer segmentation model; Ideal Customer Profile for EaaS; Segment-specific value proposition; Target account list and prioritisation.
